label: Map
sourceHint: games/pizza/raw-assets/json/map/tiles.json — ground/resource tile lookup for the grounds.png/resources.png spritesheets; resources[].providerType assigns which Provider spawns on that tile (read by TileMapConfig.ts's buildResourceSpawnsFromTileMap())

label: Zones
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/data/ZoneTypes.ts (ZONE_CONFIG) — per-zone unlock requirement (gate/building/resource); zone numbers are read live from the map's own "zones" tilelayer, not hand-typed

label: Zone Tutorial
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/tutorial/ZoneTutorialTypes.ts (ZONE_TUTORIAL_CONFIG) — ordered craft/gate step list + guidance-arrow texture per zone; zone numbers are read live from the map's own "zones" tilelayer, same as the Zones tab

label: Colors
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/data/ZoneColorTypes.ts (ZONE_COLOR_CONFIG) — one dotted-outline color per named zone kind (dropper/trigger/queue/craft/farm/...), centralized here instead of a hardcoded constant per file

label: Gates
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/data/GateTypes.ts (GATE_CONFIG)

label: Buildings
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/data/BuildingTypes.ts (BUILDING_CONFIG)

label: Queues
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/data/QueueTypes.ts (DEFAULT_QUEUE_CONFIG, QUEUE_CONFIG_BY_ID) — cooldown/requirement/popup for the zone itself; a queue id with an entry on the Quest Givers tab ignores this tab's own Possible Tasks and draws from that giver's Loot Table instead

label: Farms
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/data/FarmTypes.ts (DEFAULT_FARM_PLOT_CONFIG, FARM_PLOT_CONFIG_BY_ID) — price/tile-state for a "farm"-typed plot drawn on the map; plot ids are read from the map's own mapSettings layer, not hand-typed

label: Crops
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/data/CropTypes.ts (CROP_CONFIG) — growth-stage mesh ladder + harvest yield for a plantable crop; what it costs to plant lives on the Seeds tab instead (a seed's own cropId points here)

label: Seeds
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/data/SeedTypes.ts (SEED_CONFIG) — the bankable, plantable item; icon/models/scale/rotation route to AssetLibraryRegistry.ts, same as Resources/Providers

label: Shops
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/shop/ShopTypes.ts (SHOP_CONFIG_BY_ID)

label: Marts
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/data/MartTypes.ts (DEFAULT_MART_CONFIG, MART_CONFIG_BY_ID) — a general store buying/selling arbitrary quantities (unlike Shops' own single-tool upgrade ladder); what it sells lives in this tab's own `offers`, what it buys back is any Resources-tab entry with a Mart Price

label: Crafting
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/crafting/CraftTypes.ts (CRAFT_CONFIG_BY_ID)

label: Resources
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/actions/ResourceTypes.ts (RESOURCE_CONFIG) — the bankable item; icon/models/scale/rotation route to AssetLibraryRegistry.ts

label: Providers
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/actions/ProviderTypes.ts (PROVIDER_CONFIG) — the world dispenser (tree/deposit/bush); icon/models/scale/rotation route to AssetLibraryRegistry.ts

label: Dynamic Resources
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/world/DynamicResourceTypes.ts (DYNAMIC_RESOURCE_PLACEMENTS)

label: Shape Resources
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/world/ShapeResourceTypes.ts (SHAPE_RESOURCE_PLACEMENTS)

label: Triggers
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/data/TriggerTypes.ts (TRIGGER_CONFIG_BY_ID) — a placed "trigger" mapSettings volume that fires an effect (currently: unlock a zone) the instant the player walks into it; id must match the Tiled object's own "id" custom property

label: Actions
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/actions/ActionTypes.ts (BASE_ACTION_CONFIG)

label: Animals
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/actions/AnimalTypes.ts (ANIMAL_CONFIG) — an autonomous, wandering catch target; reference one from a Shape Resources placement with Spawn Type = animal

label: Items
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/crafting/ItemTypes.ts (ITEM_CONFIG)

label: Tools
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/actions/ToolRegistry.ts (TOOL_LIBRARY — label/icon only, visuals excluded)

label: Asset Library
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/world/AssetLibraryRegistry.ts (ASSET_LIBRARY — icon only, models/scale/rotation excluded)

label: Entity Views
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/world/EntityViewRegistry.ts (ENTITY_VIEW_CONFIG) — optional real-mesh overrides a building level/shop level/gate/queue can reference by id via its own `view` field

label: Quest Givers
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/data/QuestGiverTypes.ts (QUEST_GIVER_CONFIG_BY_ID) — OPTIONAL per queue id; adding an entry here makes that queue's Possible Tasks (Queues tab) unused and spawns an NPC that walks the map's waypoints, offering a task from its current variant's Loot Table on arrival

label: Loot Tables
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/data/LootTableTypes.ts (LOOT_TABLE_CONFIG) — reusable named task pools referenced by a Quest Giver variant's `lootTable` field

label: Character Views
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/data/CharacterViewTypes.ts (CHARACTER_VIEW_CONFIG) — selectable player appearance (color/head shape/default face); exactly one entry should be flagged Starter

label: Particle Effects
sourceHint: games/pizza/game/vfx/ParticleRegistry.ts (PARTICLE_REGISTRY) — reusable 2D particle emitter presets (texture/tint/fade/size/speed); pick one on any entity that carries a Particle Effect field (e.g. Crafting)
